summary:
Mars Habitat Resource Manager is an advanced, real-time life support and resource tracking software designed specifically for astronauts on long-duration crewed space missions and Martian habitats. The system ensures continuous monitoring of critical life support consumables, environmental parameters, and crew health indicators to maximize mission safety and operational efficiency in hostile extraterrestrial environments.

Key Modules & Features:
- Oxygen & Air Supply Monitor: Tracks real-time O2 levels, cabin pressure, and CO2 scrubbers status, issuing automated alerts during atmospheric anomalies.
- Water Recycling & Storage Tracker: Monitors greywater purification rates, daily consumption quotas, and reserve tank levels to ensure sustainable life support.
- Solar Power & Energy Distribution: Manages energy generation from photovoltaic arrays, battery storage banks, and power routing across habitat modules.
- Crew Status Panel: Integrates astronaut health metrics—such as vital signs, radiation exposure levels, and sleep-wake cycles—for proactive medical triage.
